sources.title: Public Housing policy: admission (2-1), residency preferences (4-4–4-5), and preference verification (7-23)
evidence: Page 2-1 discusses HUD income limits and an 80%-AMI admission threshold; the program overview instead states 50%. Agency clarification is needed.
Pages 4-4–4-5 treat residency as a preference and list a category for applicants without that preference.
Page 7-23 states that working-preference verification uses recent paystub(s) or a statement from the employer. This is preference evidence, not proof of full eligibility.

programs.name: County Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher
programs.organization: Housing Authority of the County of San Diego (HACSD)
programs.description: Rental assistance paid toward a participating home. The County waiting list is closed to new applicants; people already on it can keep their existing application up to date.
programs.coverage: 13 County-served cities and unincorporated communities; other cities have separate housing authorities.

availability.detail: Closed to new waiting-list applications. The HCV page reports closure on February 20, 2026 at 11:59 p.m.

programs.documentNote: A full, current program-specific document acceptance list has not been modeled. Do not treat practice-plan pay stubs or employer letters as accepted evidence for this program. Ask HACSD for the checklist for your case.
cautions: The housing authority, not BridgeBack, determines eligibility after selection.
Local residence/work preferences are not treated as automatic disqualification. Choosing another city directs you to its authority instead.
The closed waiting list is not emergency shelter. For help tonight, call 211.

programs.name: County Public Housing
programs.organization: Housing Authority of the County of San Diego (HACSD)
programs.description: Publicly owned rental housing for qualifying households. Application directions say this waiting list is closed, while the overview still describes an online application. Income and residency wording also differs between the overview and policy; ask the County which rules apply.
programs.coverage: The County lists 13 served cities and unincorporated areas. Public housing units are in Chula Vista and San Marcos.

availability.detail: The application-directions page says new waiting-list applications are closed. Its wording conflicts with the apply-online description in the program overview; confirm with the County.

programs.documentNote: The policy (page 7-23) lists recent paystub(s) OR an employer statement for the working-family preference. This is a specific preference-verification option, not a complete application checklist or proof of eligibility. Ask HACSD whether it applies to your case.
cautions: The overview states 50%-AMI income, but the admissions policy describes an 80%-AMI threshold. BridgeBack shows both published figures and does not disqualify you based on the 50% overview value.
The policy treats residency as a preference and includes applicants who lack it. BridgeBack does not turn living outside the County authority’s jurisdiction into automatic ineligibility.
Current application instructions say the waiting list is closed. Confirm conflicting overview wording, income rules, preferences and other requirements directly with HACSD.

programs.name: Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing (HUD-VASH)
programs.organization: HACSD and the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
programs.description: Rental assistance with VA case management for veterans experiencing homelessness. The County directs people to the VA for information and assessment.
programs.coverage: San Diego County referral information; the VA confirms the appropriate service route.

availability.detail: The County publishes a VA contact route. Voucher, assessment and appointment availability have not been verified.

programs.documentNote: Do not upload military, medical, identity or financial records. Ask the VA what to bring and which referral process applies.
cautions: This is a referral route, not a voucher application or confirmation that assistance is available.
Veteran status, housing circumstances and other VA requirements must be assessed by the provider. BridgeBack does not collect those records.
